name: planrelay
description: Experimental authenticated MCP bridge from web planning to a paired local Codex worker.

interface.shortDescription: Think on the web. Build in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Experimental web-to-Codex MCP bridge. Execution defaults off; opt-in macOS process cleanup is best-effort. Requires HTTPS hosting, OAuth, device pairing and project binding. The installed Codex companion reads context and results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use PlanRelay to inspect my paired project context or a run result. Help configure the web-to-Codex workflow without exposing login credentials.
